# awscc_cloudwatch_view (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::CloudWatch::View



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the view.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the view was created.
- `definition` (String) The SQL query that defines the view.
- `description` (String) A description of the view.
- `name` (String) The name of the view. Must begin with the "view." prefix followed by lowercase alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores. View names must be unique within the account and region. If not specified, a name is generated.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `type` (String) The ownership category of the view. Views created through CloudFormation are always USER views; MANAGED views are provisioned by AWS.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the view was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.
